# 1377. Frog Position After T Seconds

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
# BFS
class Solution(object):
    def frogPosition(self, n, edges, t, target):
        """
        :type n: int
        :type edges: List[List[int]]
        :type t: int
        :type target: int
        :rtype: float
        """
        g = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for u, v in edges:
            g[u].append(v)
            g[v].append(u)
        q = deque()
        q.append((1, 1.0))
        vis = set()
        vis.add(1)
        while q and t >= 0:
            for _ in range(len(q)):
                u, p = q.popleft()
                cnt = len(g[u]) - int(u != 1)
                if u == target:
                    if t == 0 or cnt == 0:
                        return p
                    else:
                        return 0
                for v in g[u]:
                    if v not in vis:
                        vis.add(v)
                        q.append((v, p / cnt))                    
            t -= 1
        return 0
```
